IS 11188 : Part 3 : 2023 Vault (Strong Room) Doors - Part 3 Tests for Fire Resistance
ICS 13.310
ICS 13.310
MED 24
MED 24
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard (Part 3) lays down the method of tests for accessing the fire resistance capacity of vault (strong room) doors.
1.2 It is intended that the tests shall register performance during the period of exposure to fire and shall not be construed as having determined suitability of doors for use after fire exposure.
